description: ANSI-stripped CLI screens and how the served CLI profile classifies each. `resume` is the resume-verification verdict (failure markers first, then success markers): "failed" | "verified" | "none". `usageLimit` is whether a usage-limit phrase matches the lowercased, whitespace-collapsed screen. Asserted identically by src-tauri/src/cli_profile/mod.rs (Rust `regex`, the live manifest) and src/components/terminal/cliScreens.test.ts (JavaScript `RegExp`, served_profiles.json). A row that passes in one engine and fails in the other is a regex-dialect divergence.
